address: 6886 Indiana Ave suite b, Riverside, CA 92506, USA

observations: Hero section uses a large background image of the practice logo/signage with overlaid text 'WELCOME TO' and 'SERVICES WE OFFER' in white sans-serif, creating a clean but somewhat generic first impression
Patient testimonials section displays five reviews with 5-star ratings, circular blue avatar icons, and full text snippets in a vertical stack with good readability

Four-box grid layout below team photo uses teal and white boxes with clear labels ('ABOUT OUR OFFICE', 'NEW PATIENTS', 'WHAT TO EXPECT', 'GET IN TOUCH') creating strong visual hierarchy through color contrast

Services section uses a clean three-column card layout on desktop with consistent teal 'Learn More' buttons, white backgrounds, and clear service titles like 'Dental Implants' and 'Preventative Dentistry'

Mobile version maintains good usability with hamburger menu, stacked CTAs (Call Us, Get Directions, Request an Appointment) in prominent blue buttons, and readable hero text, though the hero image becomes less impactful at smaller size

rationales.visualCraft: Competent execution with real team photo and consistent teal brand color throughout, but relies on template-style layouts and generic stock imagery in hero; sits squarely at the anchor 3 level of professional but unremarkable
rationales.clarityHierarchy: Strong hierarchy with immediate identification as a dental practice, clear primary CTAs in both desktop header and mobile stacked buttons, scannable service cards, and well-organized testimonials section that guides the eye effectively
rationales.modernity: Clean flat design with generous whitespace and contemporary sans-serif typography feels current but not distinctive, using safe 2019-2021 design patterns like card grids and teal accent colors without pushing into more recent aesthetic trends
